policy.ownership: Bumper owner must be the same business and tenant as primary placement context; personal and other-business resources rejected
policy.management: Bounded playback-policy action through existing media-management endpoint and authorized placement service; expected policy revision required
policy.delivery: L6-S2 rechecked on every stage request; current policy revision and configured stage required; native stages use exact ready binding and existing provider adapter; legacy stages use established MP4 integrity check

coverage: deny before policy lookup or delivery

hosted.transition: Automatic without further user clicks after Play
hosted.source: Existing six-second published Development business-owned legacy video, reused in all three semantic positions

limitations: Hosted proof reused the same existing media source for all three positions; separate-source sequencing is covered by domain/delivery tests

Management is a bounded existing API/service capability, not a new editor or advertising dashboard
Third-party bumper reuse, future external adapters, ad-free product rules and advertising features remain deferred
